report: UIAIv2.0 — Keyless LLM Endpoint Intelligence Report
methodology: Live functional tests from production server (light cadence, no stress testing against shared free services). No leaked keys, no auth bypass, public/documented endpoints only.

verified_endpoints.name: Pollinations Text (anonymous tier)
verified_endpoints.streaming: SSE in body (regular POST with stream:true; client.stream()/aiohttp get 402 by WAF)
verified_endpoints.rate_limit: ~1 req / 3s per IP, bursts get 402/500; datacenter IPs heavily throttled
verified_endpoints.stress_test: SKIPPED BY DESIGN — shared free service, only functional tests
verified_endpoints.verdict: TIER B — last-resort fallback only. Registered in provider_router with weight 0.55.

verified_endpoints.name: Pollinations Image
verified_endpoints.verdict: TIER S for images — genuinely free and fast, returns real JPEG

verified_endpoints.name: Local g4f service (already running)
verified_endpoints.verdict: TIER A — primary keyless path already owned by engine.py

verified_endpoints.name: Self-hosted Ollama / llama.cpp / vLLM (recommended addition)
verified_endpoints.note: Only truly reliable zero-key option long-term: small model (Qwen2.5 1.5B / Llama 3.2 3B) runs fine on a small VPS; OpenAI-compatible via Ollama's /v1 API

rejected_endpoints.name: api.airforce
rejected_endpoints.reason: now requires Authorization (401); free ':free' models gated

rejected_endpoints.name: api.llm7.io
rejected_endpoints.reason: listed models return model_unavailable without paid token

rejected_endpoints.name: text.pollinations.ai/openai (legacy path)
rejected_endpoints.reason: deprecated, returns 402 even for models that work on /v1

key_findings: Truly keyless cloud LLM endpoints are nearly extinct in 2026 — Pollinations anonymous tier is the last major one and it is IP-throttled to near-unusability from datacenters.
WAF fingerprinting matters: custom User-Agent headers trigger 402; stock httpx headers pass. aiohttp streaming is blocked outright.

Sustainable zero-key UX = self-hosted small model as primary + existing g4f service + Pollinations as emergency fallback + optional server-side free-tier keys (Groq/Gemini/GitHub Models) hidden from users.
code_delivered: core/provider_router.py — registered 'pollinations' provider with circuit breaker
